Dear candidate,

Thank you for your application for the ML Engineer position. We will not move forward with your application, because your CV does not show the following required points: experience with ML in production (training, testing, deployment, monitoring), proven experience with modern deep learning techniques and Gradient Boosting Trees, proficiency with ML libraries such as TensorFlow, PyTorch, LightGBM, or Scikit-learn, and experience with AutoML flows or frameworks.

This decision was prepared with an automated system. You have the right to request a human review of this decision (GDPR Art. 22): simply reply to this message.

Kind regards
